_README: Copy to _derived/slide_labels.json on the secure machine and edit there.
This file overlays functions/deck_text.r key by key: supply only the fields
you want to change and the rest of that slide's text and wrap widths stay
as written in the repo. Keys are manifest slugs; an unknown key is reported
and ignored. Braces such as {auc} are filled by the builder at draw time.
It lives outside the repo because titles state findings.
